title: Old document versions skipped
text: Search the Documents no longer reads sub-folders like Older versions, Old, Superseded or Archive, so answers come from current documents.

title: Tolerances with + and −
text: Tolerances are split by supply, return, exhaust and outside air (and max/min, pumps, coils), each with its own + and − percent. Values already entered carried over.

title: Deleting a project removes everything
text: Deleting a project now also removes its contacts, tolerances, AI suggestions and stored document text and questions. Dropbox itself is never touched.

title: Card colors
text: Every card has a thin blue bar on top; equipment type cards turn green when that type is 100% complete.

title: Clearer buttons
text: Buttons across Hitlist now look raised and tinted, so they're easy to tell apart from input boxes.

title: Last punch list sent
text: Hitlist shows when each project's last punch list went out, from the newest file in its Dropbox Deficiency Reports folder: on the Overview and in the Monday email.

title: Monday email: shorter, with possible issues
text: The Monday email lists the 10 newest Hitlist changes (link to the rest) and shows each project's Possible issues count.

title: My projects stays on
text: The My projects tick on the projects list is remembered on each device, so it's still on when you come back.

title: Search the Documents
text: AI Tools → Search the Documents answers questions from the project's Dropbox specs, submittals, drawings and ASIs, with the file and page for each value. Tolerances can be filled in with one click.

title: Contacts: To / Cc and New email
text: Set each contact to To or Cc, then press New email to open an Outlook email with everyone filled in. It replaces Copy all emails.

title: Menu button on phones
text: On a phone held upright, the top bar's links, your name and Sign out are under the ☰ button at the top right.

title: Hitlist desktop app
text: Install Hitlist on your Windows computer from Chrome or Edge so it opens in its own window. Steps are on the Help page.

title: Tab menu on smaller screens
text: When a project's tabs don't fit on one line, like on an iPad held upright, they fold into one ☰ menu.

title: Contacts tab
text: Each project has a Contacts tab to keep its deficiency-list email list. Each contact has a name, position, company, trade and email. Copy all emails copies everyone at once for Outlook.

title: What's new in Hitlist
text: The Monday email now starts with Hitlist changes from the last 30 days, and the Help page has a What's new section.

title: Admin → What's new
text: See every change, which ones go in Monday's email and to whom, and email yourself a preview.

title: ✨ AI Tools tab
text: On each project, type, paste or dictate a rough deficiency or note (tap 🎤 on the iPad keyboard) and press Refine. Claude rewrites it the PFE way, ready to Copy into BuildingStart.

title: Completed column on the checklist
text: The last column shows whether each unit is ticked Completed in BuildingStart (✓) or not (!). It doesn't count toward Done or % complete.

title: Project tolerances
text: Enter the spec's ±% for AHUs, RTUs, fans, terminal units, outlets & inlets, pumps and coils on the Rules / Tol. tab. They show on the Overview and the AI uses them.

title: "Accepted" deficiencies count as closed
text: Items marked Accepted in BuildingStart now count as closed, like Fixed.

title: Fan sub-items: no sheave on direct drive
text: Motor Sheave MFG is no longer asked for on direct-drive fans.

title: AI Review on Deficiencies and Notes
text: Press ✎ AI Review to have Claude flag unclear deficiencies or notes and suggest clearer wording. Copy it into BuildingStart, or press Keep as is.

title: Notes tab
text: Every note from BuildingStart, project notes first, then by unit. Units with a note get a blue row and a "1 note" tag on the checklist; tap it to read.

title: Server down banner
text: If the server stops, an orange banner says so and syncs wait until it's back.

title: Users page: Send welcome and Last used
text: Resend the welcome email to anyone on the list, see the last day each person opened the app, and every sign-in is logged on the SignIns tab of the Google Sheet.

title: Tap to read deficiencies on the checklist
text: Tap the red "1 open" tag on a unit to read its open deficiencies (works on the iPad). The tag now sits under the unit name so long names can't hide it.

title: Possible issues grouped by equipment
text: On the Overview, units ticked Completed with required fields empty are grouped by equipment type, with Show all.

title: More equipment types
text: Heating coils, Coil Test, Pressure Sensors, Boilers, Duct Traverses, Face Velocity Tests and Autoflow Valves are now checked.

title: Last sync shows calendar days
text: Last sync now reads Today, Yesterday or days ago by date, so last night's sync no longer shows as Today.
